_comment: Category per brand, assigned by Agent 0 (Intake) from visiting the site. Agent -1 reads this to fill the `category` column in targets.csv. Only `skincare` may enter the skincare hook corpus (docs/DESIGN.md §4) — that corpus is the compounding asset and mixing a showerhead or a silk pillowcase into it destroys what makes it valuable. Brands with no intake yet default to `unverified`: they surfaced via skincare keyword searches so they are probably skincare, but nobody has looked.
